notice: This is a demo. Nothing was written. This is what saving the plan would write.
copyToStick: Copy the bundle ~/ritueel to a USB stick, with pending/2026-11-11-adopt-cloud-key.plan inside it. This is the stick you carry to the offline system.
bring: Root card one (00000001) and root card two (00000002), and the sign-in with your hardware key for the ceremony role.
The PINs of the cards: you type them at the terminal there, never here
The offline system, booted from its own read-only stick
whenBack: Bring the USB stick back, copy the bundle over ~/ritueel and reload this page. The new record appears in History.
